lines.en: label day7:
scene newgymbullyredux1
: So yeah, that basically sums up how I feel about phlebotomy.
lines.zh: : 嗯，对，这基本上就是我对放血疗法的全部看法。

lines.en: : That's nice and all, but I really don't remember asking you anything even remotely close to that.
lines.zh: : 说得真好，不过我真不记得自己问过哪怕沾点边的这种问题。

lines.en: : You didn't? Because I could have sworn I heard you specifically ask for my thoughts on phlebotomy.
lines.zh: : 没有吗？我敢发誓我明明听见你特地问我对放血疗法有什么看法来着。

lines.en: : Again, no. I asked you why you've been following me around for the past fifteen minutes when you're supposed to be in gym class right now.
lines.zh: : 再说一次，没有。我问的是，你这十五分钟为什么一直跟着我转，你现在明明该在体育馆上体育课。

lines.en: scene newgymbullyredux2
: Because spending time with you is much better for my health than running around the track a few times.
lines.zh: : 因为跟你待在一起，比绕着跑道跑几圈对我的健康有益多了。

lines.en: : Smooth.
lines.zh: : 真会说话。

lines.en: : {i}And{/i} true. Gym class doesn't really do anything for me since I'm already the picture of perfect health.
lines.zh: : {i}而且{/i}还是实话。体育课对我真没什么用，毕竟我本来就是健康本身的化身。

lines.en: : Plus, doesn't walking down the hall with someone so clearly in love with you make you feel all masculine and important and stuff?
lines.zh: : 再说了，跟一个这么明显爱着你的人一起走走廊，难道不会让你觉得自己特别有男人味、特别了不起什么的吗？

lines.en: : Not really. It just feels like any other day to me so far.
lines.zh: : 没什么感觉。到目前为止，对我来说跟平常任何一天没两样。

lines.en: : Sure! Except you're going to spend the rest of the day with me and you never really do that, so it can't be {i}that{/i} normal. Right, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 当然啦！只不过你接下来一整天都要跟我一起过，而你平常根本不会这样，所以这日子也不可能{i}那么{/i}普通吧。对吧，Sensei？

lines.en: : Ayane, go away or you're going to get me in trouble.
lines.zh: : Ayane，走开，不然你要害我挨骂了。

lines.en: scene newgymbullyredux3
: For real? I thought this was the part where you take me to your super-secret sex dungeon and show me all of your cool...sex tools.
lines.zh: : 真的假的？我还以为接下来这段该是你带我去你那个超级秘密性爱地牢，然后给我看你那些厉害的……性爱道具。

lines.en: : If I had a super-secret sex dungeon, I can assure you it wouldn’t be on[school] grounds.
lines.zh: : 我要是真有个超级秘密性爱地牢，我可以向你保证，它绝不会建在[school]里。

lines.en: scene newgymbullyredux4
: Sure, Sensei. That’s just what you {i}want{/i} me to think.
lines.zh: : 是是是，Sensei。你就是{i}想{/i}让我这么以为罢了。

lines.en: : Ayane, seriously. I am exercising my teacher powers to demand you go to the gym right now. I have to walk around the halls and look important and you are getting in the way of that.
lines.zh: : Ayane，说真的。我现在要行使我做老师的权力，命令你立刻去体育馆。我得在走廊里巡视、摆出一副很重要的样子，而你正在妨碍我。

lines.en: scene newgymbullyredux5
: How come {i}I{/i} have to go but not you?! You know that your duties as a teacher include physical education as well, right?!
lines.zh: : 凭什么{i}我{/i}得去你不用？！你知道老师的职责里也包含体育课的吧？！

lines.en: : Wait, they do? Since when?
lines.zh: : 等等，真的吗？从什么时候开始的？

lines.en: : Since always. It wasn't until recently that you started skipping that period, so I figured I'd follow you around today and try to figure out why.
lines.zh: : 一直都是。你是最近才开始翘那节课的，所以我今天就决定跟着你转转，看看到底是为什么。

lines.en: : That's nice and all, but how does going on a rant about phlebotomy and asking me to take you to a sex dungeon have anything to do with that?
lines.zh: : 心意我领了，可你大谈特谈放血疗法、还要我带你去性爱地牢，跟这个有什么关系？

lines.en: scene newgymbullyredux6
: The phlebotomy thing was just a tangent, but if you really do have a sex dungeon, I will understand why you haven't been showing up to gym lately.
lines.zh: : 放血疗法什么的只是跑题了啦，不过你要是真有个性爱地牢，那我就能理解你最近为什么不去上体育课了。

lines.en: : There is no sex dungeon, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 没有什么性爱地牢，Ayane。

lines.en: scene newgymbullyredux7
: Okay, but there should be. I can't really think of any place better for one of those.
lines.zh: : 好吧，但应该有才对。我想不出还有什么地方比这儿更适合放一个了。

lines.en: : I have a guy who's really good at installing those fake bookcase door thingies if you need help preparing one.
lines.zh: : 你要是准备弄一个的话，我认识个很会装那种假书架暗门的人，可以帮你。

lines.en: : I actually already have my own secret room at school that I haven't told you about. You can put yours right next to mine and we can talk to each other through the wall.
lines.zh: : 其实我在学校里就已经有一间没告诉过你的秘密房间了。你可以把你的挨着我的建，我们还能隔着墙说话。

lines.en: : Why would you possibly need a secret room in school?
lines.zh: : 你到底为什么需要在学校里有间秘密房间啊？

lines.en: : I don't know. For secret stuff?
lines.zh: : 不知道啊。用来做秘密的事？

lines.en: : You'll never know when you need a secret room, Sensei. I learned {i}that{/i} in the war.
lines.zh: : 你永远不知道自己什么时候会需要一间秘密房间，Sensei。{i}这{/i}可是我在战争里学到的。

lines.en: scene newgymbullyredux8
: Anyway, wanna head to the gym and stare at my legs while I walk around in bloomers?
lines.zh: : 总之，要不要去体育馆，看我穿着灯笼裤走来走去的腿？

lines.en: : It's a nice alternative to the sex dungeon. Also, I think if you miss {i}another{/i} gym period Makoto will actually kill you.
lines.zh: : 这可是性爱地牢的绝佳替代品。而且我觉得，你要是{i}再{/i}翘一节体育课，Makoto 是真的会杀了你。

lines.en: : You know, I'm honestly surprised I missed any at all since bloomers are involved.
lines.zh: : 说真的，既然有灯笼裤可以看，我居然还翘过课，连我自己都挺意外的。

lines.en: : I hereby promise to never miss another gym period again. And it's all thanks to you, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 我在此保证，再也不会翘任何一节体育课了。这一切都多亏了你，Ayane。

lines.en: : Your words are no good here, Sensei. You can thank me by staring at me longer than the other girls and occasionally winking at me to remind me that I'm your #1.
lines.zh: : 光说可没用哦，Sensei。你要谢我的话，就看我看得比别的女生久一点，再偶尔朝我眨个眼，提醒我我是你的第一名。

lines.en: : I...will do my best, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 我……会尽力的，Ayane。

lines.en: scene black
{i}Meanwhile...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}与此同时……{/i}

lines.en: scene gymbully1
: The fuck is even the point of havin' a teacher if {i}he{/i} is goin' to be the one who fucking skips class?
lines.zh: : {i}他{/i}妈的老师自己还翘课，那要老师到底有什么意义啊？

lines.en: : Why'd I even leave the dorm in the first place? Could've just stayed at fuckin' home and it would've made literally zero difference.
lines.zh: : 我一开始干嘛要出宿舍啊？干脆待在家里得了，反正根本没任何区别。

lines.en: scene gymbully2
: Yumi, chill. You don't have to always talk like such a thug, you know?
lines.zh: : Yumi，冷静点。你也不用讲话非得跟个混混似的吧？

lines.en: : Besides, the things you're saying right now make it sound like you {i}want{/i} Sensei here. Doesn't that go against your whole...thing?
lines.zh: : 再说了，你现在说的这些听起来好像很{i}希望{/i} Sensei 在这儿。这跟你那一整套……人设不冲突吗？

lines.en: scene gymbully3
: What {i}thing?{/i} And I ain't talkin' like a thug! This is just how I fuckin' talk!
lines.zh: : 什么{i}人设？{/i}还有我才没说话像个混混！我他妈平时就是这么说话的！

lines.en: scene gymbully4
: Yeah, well, the way you normally talk sounds the same as how a thug normally talks. Do with that what you will.
lines.zh: : 行吧，可你平时说话的方式听起来跟混混说话一模一样。你自己看着办。

lines.en: : Oh, give me a break. The fuck do {i}you{/i} know about how people on the streets talk?
lines.zh: : 哦，饶了我吧。{i}你{/i}他妈懂什么叫街上的人怎么说话？

lines.en: : However much I've learned from you over the last couple years, I guess.
lines.zh: : 大概就是这两三年里从你身上学到的那么多吧。

lines.en: scene gymbully5
: And why the fuck are {i}you{/i} just sitting there? I don't remember inviting you to hang out with us.
lines.zh: : 还有{i}你{/i}他妈干嘛就坐在这儿？我不记得有邀请你跟我们一起混啊。

lines.en: : Yumi, Futaba was there before we even sat down.
lines.zh: : Yumi，我们还没坐下呢，Futaba 就已经在那儿了。

lines.en: : Well she should have {i}left{/i} as soon as we sat down.
lines.zh: : 那我们一坐下她就该{i}走{/i}才对。

lines.en: : {size=-10}I don't...really have anything to-{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-10}我……其实没什么好说的——{/size}

lines.en: : Speak the fuck up. I can't hear you.
lines.zh: : 他妈大声点。我听不见。

lines.en: scene gymbully6
: Umm...I said I...don’t really have anything to say.
lines.zh: : 呃……我说我……真的没什么可说的。

lines.en: scene gymbully7
: Figures. You {i}never{/i} have anything to say, do you.
lines.zh: : 果然。你{i}从来{/i}就没什么可说的，对吧。

lines.en: : All you do is just fuckin' sit there taking up half the gym and making that one girl who's always hanging around you look like fifty times better than she actually is.
lines.zh: : 你成天就他妈坐在那儿，占掉半个体育馆，还衬托得那个老围着你转的女生比她本人好看五十倍。

lines.en: scene gymbully8
: That {i}girl{/i} has a name, Yumi. It's Rin.
lines.zh: : 那个{i}女生{/i}有名字的，Yumi。她叫 Rin。

lines.en: : And the fact that you even need to be reminded of that when you have known her since middle school is pretty unbelievable.
lines.zh: : 你们从中学就认识了，你居然还需要别人提醒，真是让人难以置信。

lines.en: scene gymbully9
: You sayin' that I'm just {i}pretending{/i} to not remember her name? The fuck is your problem today?
lines.zh: : 你是在说我{i}装作{/i}不记得她名字？你他妈今天吃错什么药了？

lines.en: : {i}My{/i} problem? I've been sitting here for the last ten minutes looking up sales on Amazon while all {i}you've{/i} done is bitch and moan about literally everything.
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}吃错药？我在这儿坐了十分钟刷亚马逊的打折，而{i}你{/i}从头到尾就只会他妈抱怨这个抱怨那个。

lines.en: scene gymbully10
: Yeah, well...it's a free country, ain't it? I can bitch and moan about whatever I want, {i}whenever{/i} I want and you can't do shit.
lines.zh: : 是又怎样……这是个自由的国家，不是吗？我想抱怨什么就抱怨什么，想{i}什么时候{/i}抱怨就什么时候抱怨，你他妈管不着。

lines.en: scene gymbully11
: Ugh...Why do I even bother?
lines.zh: : 呃……我到底为什么要操这份心啊？

lines.en: : Hey. {i}You{/i} must know where our fucking asshole teacher is, right?
lines.zh: : 喂。{i}你{/i}肯定知道我们那个混蛋老师在哪儿吧？

lines.en: : Figure since you're always starin' at him and shit that you probably just know where he is at all times.
lines.zh: : 我猜你老盯着他看什么的，大概随时都知道他在哪儿。

lines.en: : The fuck is up with that anyway? You trying to suck his dick or something?
lines.zh: : 说起来你到底怎么回事？你打算给他口交还是怎么的？

lines.en: scene gymbully13
: Wh...What?!
: Yumi, are you fucking kidding me right now? Listen to yourself. Futaba did literally {i}nothing{/i} to you.
lines.zh: : Yumi，你他妈在开什么玩笑？听听你自己说的话。Futaba 根本{i}什么都没{/i}对你做过。

lines.en: : Of course she did literally nothing to me. Fatass probably hasn't done a single fucking thing in her life.
lines.zh: : 她当然什么都没对我做过。那个死胖子这辈子恐怕连一件他妈的事都没做过。

lines.en: scene gymbully14
: Hey, why don't you get up and go look for him or something? You could use the exercise, right?
lines.zh: : 喂，你不如起来去找他什么的？你正该运动运动，对吧？

lines.en: : Yumi, knock it the fuck off right now! I'm serious!
lines.zh: : Yumi，你他妈立刻给我住嘴！我是认真的！

lines.en: scene gymbully16
: Oh yeah? {i}How{/i} serious, Chika? You gonna fight me if I keep goin' or something?
lines.zh: : 哦是吗？{i}有多{/i}认真，Chika？我要是继续说下去，你还要跟我打一架不成？

lines.en: : You'd love that wouldn't you? But no, I'm not going to fight you just because you woke up and decided to be a fucking bitch today.
lines.zh: : 你倒是很想是吧？不过不行，我不会因为你今天一觉醒来决定当个婊子就跟你打。

lines.en: : Seriously, though. Why did you even come here if this is all you planned on doing?
lines.zh: : 不过说真的。你要是就打算干这些，那你干嘛还来这儿？

lines.en: : Hey, I didn't {i}plan{/i} this. If anything, it's our fucking teacher's fault this is happening since none of this shit would be going on if he just did his job for once.
lines.zh: : 喂，这可不是我{i}计划{/i}的。要说怪谁，就怪我们那个混蛋老师，他哪怕有那么一次好好干活，这些破事就都不会发生。

lines.en: scene gymbully17
: That is fucking bullshit and you know it.
lines.zh: : 这他妈全是胡说八道，你自己心里清楚。

lines.en: : Hey, Futaba. I'm really sorry for being in such a bad mood today.
lines.zh: : 喂，Futaba。我今天心情这么差，真是抱歉啊。

lines.en: : I just...
lines.zh: : 我只是……

lines.en: : Well, I really {i}really{/i} care about all of the starving children out there. And knowing you could singlehandedly end world hunger by just giving up your lunch for the day kinda triggers me.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我真的真的{i}非常{/i}关心外面那些挨饿的孩子。一想到你只要把今天的午饭让出来就能凭一己之力终结世界饥荒，我就有点上火。

lines.en: scene gymbully19
: Okay, that’s it!
lines.zh: : 好，够了！

lines.en: : Futaba, come with me. We'll find Sensei together and let {i}him{/i} deal with Yumi's BS so you don't have to.
lines.zh: : Futaba，跟我走。我们一起去把 Sensei 找来，让{i}他{/i}去收拾 Yumi 那些破事，你就不必受这份罪了。

lines.en: : I don't understand...
lines.zh: : 我不明白……

lines.en: : Hahaha...hahahahaha!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈……哈哈哈哈哈哈！

lines.en: scene gymbully20
: Oh, come on! It was just a joke! We all know it's in good fun, right?!
lines.zh: : 哦，拜托！只是开个玩笑而已！大家都知道这很好玩嘛，对吧？！

lines.en: : Fuck off, Yumi! You can sleep in the dorm yourself tonight. I'll go stay with Chinami myself.
lines.zh: : 滚开，Yumi！今晚你自己在宿舍睡。我去跟 Chinami 住。

lines.en: scene black
scene newgymbullyredux9
: Hey, sorry I’m late. I got a little caught up in-
lines.zh: : 嘿，抱歉我来晚了。我这边稍微被点事缠住了——

lines.en: : That doesn't matter right now. Can you take Futaba to the nurse's office for a little while?
lines.zh: : 现在这不重要。你能带 Futaba 去保健室待一会儿吗？

lines.en: : Oh. Sure. Is something wrong?
lines.zh: : 哦。当然可以。出什么事了吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, Yumi. For whatever reason, she just decided to torment the poor girl again today.
lines.zh: : 嗯，Yumi。不知道为什么，她今天又决定要折磨那个可怜的女孩了。

lines.en: : I'm fine...I really don't-
lines.zh: : 我没事……我真的不——

lines.en: scene newgymbullyredux10
: I know you're fine. You deal with this way too much and I'm really sorry that Yumi's constantly saying things like that to you. It's really not fair.
lines.zh: : 我知道你没事。只是你承受这种事已经太多了，Yumi 老这么对你说那些话，我真的觉得很抱歉。这太不公平了。

lines.en: : I just don't want her to keep going...and getting Yumi out of the gym would take an entire militia at this rate.
lines.zh: : 我只是不想让她继续下去……而照现在这架势，要把 Yumi 弄出体育馆得动用一整支民兵队。

lines.en: : So just...cool off and relax with Sensei for a little while. He'll know how to handle this.
lines.zh: : 所以就……先跟 Sensei 去冷静一下、放松一会儿。他会知道该怎么处理的。

lines.en: That is giving me far too much credit for something I am absolutely not prepared to deal with.
lines.zh: 这可真是太高看我了，这事我压根就没准备好要处理。

lines.en: scene newgymbullyredux11
: I'm sorry, Sensei...I didn't mean to inconvenience you...
lines.zh: : 对不起，Sensei……我不是有意要给你添麻烦的……

lines.en: : It's not an inconvenience at all.
lines.zh: : 这一点都不麻烦。

lines.en: : Let's just...head over to the nurse's office and hang out there until gym is over...
lines.zh: : 我们就……去保健室待着，等到体育课结束吧……

lines.en: : I'm sorry again, Futaba...I'll talk to Yumi for the millionth time later tonight.
lines.zh: : 再次跟你说声抱歉，Futaba……今晚我会第一百万次去跟 Yumi 谈谈的。

lines.en: scene newgymbullyredux12
: It's fine...really. And thank you for standing up to her...
lines.zh: : 没关系的……真的。还有，谢谢你替我出头……

lines.en: : It means a lot, Chika...It really does...
lines.zh: : 这对我意义重大，Chika……真的……

lines.en: : Of course. I've got you, girl.
lines.zh: : 当然啦。我罩着你，姐妹。

lines.en: scene newgymbullyredux13
: And, between you and me, the only reason that I {i}didn't{/i} fight her back there is because I wouldn't be able to afford her hospital bills.
lines.zh: : 还有，就咱俩说说，我刚才{i}没{/i}跟她动手的唯一原因，是我付不起她的医药费。

lines.en: : She might talk big, but that girl ain't got shit on me.
lines.zh: : 她嘴上倒是挺能说，不过那丫头根本不是我的对手。

lines.en: : Hahah...hah......hah...
scene black
Futaba and I take a walk over to the nurse's office, but she's so embarrassed by whatever happened while I was away that she doesn't say anything the entire time.
lines.zh: 我和 Futaba 一路走向保健室，但她对我不在时发生的事羞耻得要命，一路上什么都没说。

lines.en: Eventually, the bell rings and she waves me off so she can walk back to the locker room and get changed.
lines.zh: 终于，铃声响了，她挥手让我走，好自己回更衣室换衣服。

lines.en: And despite how I know I should be walking back with her to make sure she's okay, I understand that being alone might just be...better for her in her current condition.
lines.zh: 虽然我知道自己该陪她走回去、确认她没事，但我也明白，以她现在的状态，一个人待着或许……对她更好。

lines.en: I'll definitely have to talk to Yumi about this, though.
lines.zh: 不过，我肯定得为这件事找 Yumi 谈谈。

lines.en: I still have no idea how to deal with her, but...
lines.zh: 我依然完全不知道该怎么应付她，但是……

lines.en: I can't just let this go on if it's going to be affecting some of the other girls this badly.
lines.zh: 如果这会让其他一些女生受到这么大的伤害，我就不能由着它继续下去。
